title: DevOps Engineer
descriptionText:
WHO WE ARE

Come join the company reinventing data security, empowering businesses to realize the full potential of their data. As the leading data security platform purpose-built for the cloud era, Cyera’s mission is to reinvent how businesses secure data, enable agile collaboration, and boldly pursue new business opportunities. Trusted by security teams at leading global businesses, our team is proving that data security is the next big thing in cyber. Backed by the world’s leading investors and working with a large and growing list of Fortune 1000 companies, we are looking for world-class talent to join us as we usher in the new era of data security.

﻿THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking a highly skilled DevOps Engineer to join our fast-growing data security startup. In this role, you will design, build, and optimize the infrastructure and automation that power our platform. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Security, and Product teams to ensure our environments are secure, scalable, resilient, and highly automated, enabling us to deliver best-in-class data protection solutions for modern enterprises.

This is a high-impact position where you’ll help establish DevOps best practices, shape our cloud-native architecture, and influence key technical decisions as we scale.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Infrastructure & Automation

Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) with a focus on security, high availability, and scalability.
Build and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tools.
Automate provisioning, configuration, and deployment pipelines across development, staging, and production environments.

CI/CD & Release Engineering

Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.).
Implement automated testing, security scanning, and deployment workflows.
Improve release velocity while ensuring reliability and compliance.

Security & Compliance

Embed security into infrastructure and deployment practices (“DevSecOps”).
Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for security events and system performance.
Collaborate with security teams to meet compliance requirements (SOC2, ISO 27001, etc.).

Reliability & Observability

Own uptime, performance, and scalability of services in production.
Implement observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog, etc.).
Drive incident response, root cause analysis, and long-term system improvements.

Collaboration & Culture

Work cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams.
Evangelize DevOps best practices and contribute to a culture of automation, reliability, and continuous improvement.
Document infrastructure, processes, and runbooks for internal teams.

Requirements:

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

3–5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Platform Engineering, or similar roles.
Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration.
Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred).
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
Solid understanding of networking, security principles, and Linux systems.
Strong scripting abilities (Python, Bash, Go, etc.).
Experience with monitoring and observability tools.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Clearance eligible

COMPENSATION INFORMATION:

Compensation Range: $160,000-$200,000.

The range represents total compensation, and may include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

This compensation range represents Cyera’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of posting, and Cyera may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. The final salary for this position will be determined in Cyera’s sole discretion, consistent with applicable law, and based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the employee’s work experience, skills, and qualifications for the role, as well as the needs of Cyera’s business and other operational considerations.

Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements.

This role may be eligible for potential merit increases based on factors such as individual or company performance, time in role, and other discretionary factors.

BENEFITS - Why Cyera?

Ability to work remotely, with office setup reimbursement
Competitive salary
Unlimited PTO
Paid holidays and sick time
Health, vision, and dental insurance
Life, short and long-term disability insurance

title: DevOps Engineer
descriptionText:
About the Role:

Dev Ops Engineer

 Description of Position: As a DevOps Engineer, you will take a lead role in architecting, optimizing, and maintaining the reliability, scalability, and security of our cloud and on-premise software platforms. You will guide the evolution of our DevOps practices, mentor junior engineers, and influence strategic decisions around infrastructure, automation, and system performance. This position requires deep technical expertise, strong ownership, and the ability to collaborate across teams to drive continuous improvement.

Duties and Responsibilities: Primary responsibilities of the position include designing, building, and maintaining scalable and efficient CI/CD pipelines to ensure smooth and timely delivery of high-quality software releases. You will automate tasks using configuration management tools such as Ansible and Terraform to improve the efficiency and reliability of the development and operations process.

 Other duties may include:

 Lead root-cause investigation and resolution of complex system issues to minimize downtime and disruptions.
 • Oversee monitoring, logging, and observability strategies to ensure performance, availability, and proactive alerting across environments.
 • Design and manage enterprise-grade CI/CD workflows using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and similar platforms.
 • Architect containerization strategies and manage workloads using Kubernetes, Docker, and Swarm to increase portability, scalability, and operational efficiency.
 • Lead the migration, modernization, and ongoing management of infrastructure in Kubernetes using Helm, Docker, and cloud-native tools.
 • Collaborate closely with development, product, and operations teams to ensure infrastructure, tooling, and automation support business and technical priorities.
 • Define, implement, and enforce security, compliance, and governance standards across infrastructure, pipelines, and cloud environments.
 • Champion best practices, documentation standards, and DevOps methodologies across the organization.
 • Mentor and support junior engineers and contribute to a culture of technical excellence.
 • Perform additional IT-related tasks as needed.

Qualifications needed to be successful:

 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering or related field.

Proficiency with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google cloud.

Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies like Docker or Kubernetes.

Strong knowledge of CI/CD tools.

Familiarity with infrastructure code.

Proficient in scripting languages such as Bash, Python or PowerShell.

Excellent problem-solving skills.

Strong communication and teamwork skills.

Highly organized and self-motivated

What we offer:

 Career/Professional Development Training

Full Medical, Dental and Vision

Supplemental Life Insurance

Maternity/Paternity Leave

Employee Stock Options

Employee Activities

401k Contribution

Paid Time Off

7 Paid Holidays

On-site Gym

Generous Employee Referral Program

title: DevOps Engineer
descriptionText:
Job Description

The candidate must have detailed experience with AWS and all of its resources (or least its main ones EC2, S3, and RDS), as well as very familiar with Cloudformation to create and maintain AWS resources. The candidate must also have experience with programming in an Object Oriented Programming language, preferably in Ruby or Python. This candidate should also have experience with Java as well to help assist the development teams as needed since their applications are written in Java. The candidate should have experience with using the AWS Ruby SDK, AWS python SDK (botocore), and AWS Java SDK. This experience will be vital in helping the development teams utilize AWS correctly.
,
About Sequoia, Inc.

Sequoia builds full lifecycle software systems, enterprise cloud solutions, and real time big data applications for our IC Community and Department of Defense customers. Our Classified Cloud Emulator, Combine, is a sandbox environment for developers to test solutions before deploying code into classified cloud regions – enabling low to high development.

title: DevOps Engineer
descriptionText:
Valorem Reply is an award-winning digital transformation firm focused on delivering solutions around data-driven enterprise, IT modernization, customer experience, product transformation and digital workplace by leveraging the power of Microsoft technologies. We provide hyper-scale and agile delivery of unique digital business services, strategic business models and design-led user experiences. Our innovative strategies and solutions securely and rapidly transform the way our clients do business.

We are hiring a DevOps Engineer to design, automate, and scale cloud-native infrastructure supporting enterprise-grade applications. This role will own Kubernetes environments, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platform operations in Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The ideal candidate brings strong automation discipline and experience operating production-grade distributed systems.
Responsibilities
 Design, deploy, and operate Kubernetes clusters in production environments
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support secure and repeatable deployments
Implement and manage service mesh architectures using Istio
Administer and optimize Google Cloud Platform infrastructure
Integrate Jira workflows into development and release processes
Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve reliability, performance, and security
Collaborate with engineering teams to implement infrastructure as code and automation standards
Additional duties as required
Minimum Requirements
5 years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering
3 years of hands-on Kubernetes administration in production environments
3 years of experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
3 years of experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
2 years of experience implementing and managing Istio service mesh
Experience administering Jira for engineering workflow management
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform or similar)
Experience with container security and vulnerability management
Experience supporting microservices-based architectures
Google Cloud Professional certification
Experience operating highly available distributed systems
About Reply

Reply specializes in the design and implementation of solutions based on new communication channels and digital media. Reply is a network of highly specialized companies supporting global industrial groups operating in the telecom and media, industry and services, banking, insurance and public administration sectors in the definition and development of business models enabled for the new paradigms of AI, cloud computing, digital media and the Internet of Things. Reply services include Consulting, System Integration and Digital Services.

Reply is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to provide equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you need assistance and reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, email us at jobusa@reply.com. Visit our website at www.reply.com to learn more about our open roles.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer - Remote
descriptionText:
*The SportsBiz Opportunity*

Are you passionate about building clean, scalable software? Do you thrive in a fast-paced startup, where your work directly impacts the direction of the product and company? Are you excited by analytics, automation, and the potential of AI to reshape how decisions get made?

SportsBiz (SportsBiz.com) is revolutionizing the $100B sports sponsorship industry with DeepSport Solutions, our proprietary analytics and decision-intelligence platform. We empower brands to uncover inefficiencies, optimize spend, and make smarter investments through advanced data science, automation, and intuitive GenAI software.

We’re looking for a highly skilled, motivated Senior DevOps Engineer to help build out the SportsBiz Application Platform.

*Important – Compensation Structure*

Transparency is our culture.

SportsBiz's valuation as of Q4 2025 is $25M pre-money. Management is presently engaged in a $5M advanced seed round. With that said, all current team members are compensated through:

* *Equity *(until fundraising closes, anticipated Q1/Q2)
* *Full salary + Equity + Benefits *commence immediately after successful funding

This role is ideal for candidates who are energized by early-stage building and want meaningful ownership and impact.

*Full-Time Responsibilities:*

Senior DevOps Engineer

Are you a DevOps innovator who thrives on building scalable, automated, cloud-native systems?

* Do you love designing robust pipelines and infrastructure that just _work_?
* Do you excel in high-speed, high-autonomy startup environments?
* Want to help shape the backbone of an AI-powered analytics platform transforming a $100B industry?

If this sounds like you—SportsBiz wants you on our engineering team.

We’re seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer to own and evolve our cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, and developer experience. You’ll ensure the reliability, scalability, and security of the systems that power everything we build.

What You’ll DoArchitect, Build & Maintain Cloud Infrastructure

* Own, manage, and optimize our AWS environment (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch, etc.).
* Administer Google Cloud accounts, including permissions, security policies, and cost controls.

Design & Maintain Automation Pipelines

* Build and improve CI/CD pipelines across multiple repositories and services.
* Implement and advance our Infrastructure-as-Code initiatives (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, etc.).

Collaborate with data engineering and data science to support Databricks workflows, jobs, clusters, and deployment pipelines.Collaborate Across Engineering and Product

* Work closely with full-stack developers, data scientists, and product leaders.
* Align infrastructure decisions with business needs and technical roadmaps.

Develop Internal Tools & Services

* Contribute to development using React, Python, and Node.js where needed.
* Build automation tools and scripts that streamline development and operations.

Ensure Security, Reliability & Observability

* Configure monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure 24/7 operational visibility.
* Troubleshoot incidents, implement root-cause fixes, and improve system resilience.
* Enforce strong cloud security and access control practices.

Requirements — What You BringCore Technical Requirements

* 5+ years in DevOps, SRE, Cloud Engineering, or similar role.
* Extensive hands-on experience with AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, Load Balancing, CloudWatch).
* Demonstrated experience managing Google Cloud accounts and identity/security configurations.Experience supporting Databricks environments—including clusters, jobs, repos, workflows, and access configurations.

* Strong programming ability in Python, Node.js, and comfort with React for internal tooling.
* Expert-level experience with CI/CD platforms (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Travis CI, etc.).
* Solid experience with Docker and modern container orchestration (Kubernetes, ECS, EKS, GKE).
* Strong Terraform or CloudFormation experience (IaC is essential).
* Familiarity with cloud networking, VPNs, load balancers, and microservices architecture.

Compensation

$80,000–$100,000 per year (salary begins after funding)

_*Please note that SportsBiz is unable to support any candidate who is requires a special visa consideration or approval.*_

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $80,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

Benefits:
* Health insurance
* Paid time off



Experience:
* DevOps Engineering : 5 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

title: IT Systems Administrator
descriptionText:
We are seeking a proactive and technically skilled Systems Administrator to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining and optimizing our IT infrastructure, ensuring system reliability, security, and performance. Your expertise will support our mission to deliver seamless service experiences through robust system design, management, and continuous improvement. This role is full time, Monday - Friday, and will report to our office location in RI.

*Responsibilities*

* Manage and maintain enterprise IT infrastructure including servers, networks, and virtualization platforms such as VMware and ESXi.
* Oversee system architecture design for scalable solutions utilizing cloud platforms like AWS and Azure.
* Implement and monitor security protocols including firewalls, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, and information security best practices.
* Administer databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and Microsoft SQL Server—performing backups, tuning performance, and ensuring data integrity.
* Develop automation scripts using Bash (Unix shell), Python, PowerShell, and other scripting languages to streamline operations.
* Support system engineering projects involving load balancing with tools like Kubernetes and solution architecture for microservices environments.
* Maintain documentation for system configurations, procedures, and SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) processes using tools like Git and Jenkins.

*Skills*

* Deep understanding of operating systems including Windows and Linux distributions.
* Proficiency with virtualization technologies such as VMware ESXi and VMs management.
* Experience with container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes for microservices deployment.
* Knowledge of RESTful API development and integration for seamless system communication.
* Expertise in computer networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, load balancing techniques, and firewalls.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins or similar tools.
* Strong background in system design principles involving RAID controllers, solution architecture frameworks like Service-oriented architecture (SOA), and system security measures.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex issues related to system architecture or network configurations efficiently.

Join us as a Systems Administrator to be at the forefront of technological innovation within a vibrant company dedicated to excellence in home services! Your expertise will directly impact our ability to deliver reliable solutions while advancing your career in a fast-paced environment that values your skills and dedication.

Pay: $65,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:
* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off



Ability to Commute:
* Smithfield, RI 02917 (Required)

Work Location: In person
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a proactive and technically skilled Systems Administrator to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining and optimizing our IT infrastructure, ensuring system reliability, security, and performance. Your expertise will support our mission to deliver seamless service experiences through robust system design, management, and continuous improvement. This role is full time, Monday - Friday, and will report to our office location in RI.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and maintain enterprise IT infrastructure including servers, networks, and virtualization platforms such as VMware and ESXi.
  • Oversee system architecture design for scalable solutions utilizing cloud platforms like AWS and Azure.
  • Implement and monitor security protocols including firewalls, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, and information security best practices.
  • Administer databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, and Microsoft SQL Server—performing backups, tuning performance, and ensuring data integrity.
  • Develop automation scripts using Bash (Unix shell), Python, PowerShell, and other scripting languages to streamline operations.
  • Support system engineering projects involving load balancing with tools like Kubernetes and solution architecture for microservices environments.
  • Maintain documentation for system configurations, procedures, and SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) processes using tools like Git and Jenkins.

Skills

  • Deep understanding of operating systems including Windows and Linux distributions.
  • Proficiency with virtualization technologies such as VMware ESXi and VMs management.
  • Experience with container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes for microservices deployment.
  • Knowledge of RESTful API development and integration for seamless system communication.
  • Expertise in computer networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, load balancing techniques, and firewalls.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins or similar tools.
  • Strong background in system design principles involving RAID controllers, solution architecture frameworks like Service-oriented architecture (SOA), and system security measures.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues related to system architecture or network configurations efficiently.

Join us as a Systems Administrator to be at the forefront of technological innovation within a vibrant company dedicated to excellence in home services! Your expertise will directly impact our ability to deliver reliable solutions while advancing your career in a fast-paced environment that values your skills and dedication.

Pay: $65,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off

Ability to Commute:

  • Smithfield, RI 02917 (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: DevOps Cloud Engineer
descriptionText:
We are looking for a skilled DevOps Cloud Engineer to join our team on a consulting basis.
This is a Remote role.
In this role, you will play a key part in managing and optimizing cloud infrastructure while implementing DevOps practices to enhance operational efficiency. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in cloud environments, automation tools, and collaboration across teams to drive strategic improvements.

Responsibilities:
• Manage and maintain CI/CD pipelines, ensuring seamless deployment processes using GitLab.
• Oversee the cloud infrastructure, focusing on services, resources, and their integration with data pipelines.
• Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions using Terraform to streamline cloud operations.
• Handle all aspects of infrastructure management, including deployments, upgrades, patching, and proactive security measures.
• Respond to security vulnerabilities and implement strategies to strengthen system protection.
• Advocate for a DevOps mindset by providing technical leadership and fostering collaboration between development and operations teams.
• Analyze and optimize cloud architecture to ensure scalability and reliability.
• Utilize Google Cloud Platform tools and applications to enhance system performance and functionality.
• Collaborate with teams to identify and resolve technical challenges effectively.

Interviews are currently being conducted, for immediate consideration please apply.

The successful DevOps consultant will have experience leading DevOps initiatives and serving as internal subject matter expert.
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in DevOps and cloud engineering.
• Expertise in managing CI/CD pipelines and working with version control systems such as GitLab.
• Proficiency in Google Cloud Platform and familiarity with its suite of tools and applications.
• Strong knowledge of Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tools.
• Understanding of cloud data pipelines and general principles of cloud architecture.
• Proven ability to address security vulnerabilities and implement proactive measures.
• Excellent leadership and communication skills to promote collaboration across teams.
• Analytical mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Background required prior to employment
